checks.name: 연 12회 분배·순자산 1,000억 이상 분배수익률 상위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_pay_cnt AS INT) >= 12 AND TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) >= 100000000000 AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_yield AS DOUBLE),0) <> 0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_yield AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 10

checks.name: 삼성전자 비중 20% 초과 편입 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM etf_constituent c WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005930' AND TRY_CAST(replace(c.COMPST_RTO, ',', '') AS DOUBLE) > 20

checks.name: 한국전력 표기 유효 채권 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_bond WHERE drv_maturity_status='active' AND (PD_NM ILIKE '%한국전력%' OR PD_ABRV_NM ILIKE '%한국전력%')

checks.name: Japan 투자지역 해외 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM global_etf WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND wu_inv_rgn ILIKE '%Japan%'

checks.name: 순자산 5,000억 이상 총보수 하위 5
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) > 0 AND TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) >= 500000000000 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE), pd_itm_no LIMIT 5
